prompt: 为一个从未听说过中文网络梗的文生图模型，写一条独立完整的提示词，让它画出长颈鹿版的「大笑奶龙」（Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙）表情包。只输出提示词。
answer:
A cute chibi mascot sticker illustration, square 1:1 composition, single character centered and filling most of the frame, plain flat pale-cream background, clean thick dark-brown outlines, flat cel shading with one soft glossy highlight, glossy vector "messaging-app emoji sticker" look, high resolution, no text, no watermark, no border.

The character is an absurdly chubby baby creature that is half cartoon dragon, half giraffe: an enormous perfectly round head sitting on a thick but slightly elongated neck, two short stubby giraffe ossicones (knob-horns) with fuzzy dark tips on top of the head, two big soft floppy ears sticking out sideways, pale butter-yellow / cream skin covered with a few soft caramel-brown irregular giraffe patch spots, a huge round bulging belly, tiny short stubby arms and legs, and a small thin tail with a brown tuft at the end. No wings, no spikes, no realistic fur texture — smooth plush toy simplicity.

Its expression is explosive, uncontrollable laughter: head thrown back and tilted upward, mouth stretched into a gigantic wide-open grin occupying almost half the face, dark pink mouth interior with a small rounded pink tongue and no visible teeth (or two tiny bottom teeth), both eyes squeezed completely shut into thick upward-curving crescent arcs, two tiny blue teardrops of laughter flicking outward from the eye corners, round pink blush ovals on the cheeks, and a few short curved black shake/motion lines beside the head to suggest it is rocking with laughter. Overall mood: silly, gleeful, over-the-top joy; cute and slightly derpy, not scary.
